en-US.title: Ferrari Appears at High School... What Happened at Lim Young-woong's Alma Mater / YTN star
en-US.description:
Singer Lim Young-woong is garnering attention for making an unannounced visit to his alma mater in celebration of Parents' Day.

On the afternoon of the 8th, Lim Young-woong visited Dongnam High School in Soheul-eup, Pocheon-si, Gyeonggi-do, and had a surprise meeting with his juniors.

It is reported that this visit came about while he was preparing a gift for his mother in honor of Parents' Day. Afterward, Lim Young-woong visited a nearby flower shop run by a friend from his high school days to purchase flowers, then visited his alma mater to look around the classrooms where he used to study, spending time reminiscing about his school days.

In particular, the students' attention was drawn to the appearance of Lim Young-woong's Ferrari on campus. It is reported that despite appearing in a simple, unadorned state without makeup, Lim Young-woong responded to the students' requests for photos and videos with a bright smile.

[Copyright (c) YTN. Unauthorized reproduction, redistribution, and use of AI data are prohibited.]

id.title: Ferrari Muncul di Sekolah Menengah Atas... Apa yang Terjadi di Almamater Lim Young-woong? / Binta...
id.description:
Penyanyi Lim Young-woong menarik perhatian karena kunjungannya yang tak terduga ke almamaternya dalam rangka perayaan Hari Orang Tua.

Pada sore hari tanggal 8, Lim Young-woong mengunjungi SMA Dongnam di Soheul-eup, Pocheon-si, Gyeonggi-do, dan mengadakan pertemuan kejutan dengan para juniornya.

Dilaporkan bahwa kunjungan ini terjadi saat ia sedang menyiapkan hadiah untuk ibunya untuk memperingati Hari Orang Tua. Setelah itu, Lim Young-woong mengunjungi toko bunga terdekat yang dikelola oleh seorang teman dari masa SMA-nya untuk membeli bunga, kemudian mengunjungi almamaternya untuk melihat-lihat ruang kelas tempat ia dulu belajar, menghabiskan waktu mengenang masa sekolahnya.

Secara khusus, perhatian para siswa tertuju pada kehadiran Ferrari milik Lim Young-woong di kampus. Dilaporkan bahwa meskipun tampil sederhana tanpa riasan, Lim Young-woong menanggapi permintaan foto dan video dari para siswa yang mengerumuninya dengan senyum cerah. [Hak cipta (c) YTN. Reproduksi, redistribusi, dan penggunaan data AI tanpa izin dilarang.]

snippet.title: 레드카펫 위 같은 드레스...“수지는 청순, 윤아는 시크” / YTN star
snippet.description:
배우 수지와 윤아가 같은 디자인의 드레스를 입고 등장했습니다. 

지난 8일 제62회 백상예술대상 레드카펫 행사가 서울 강남구 삼성동 코엑스에서 열렸습니다. MC 수지와 참석자 윤아는 같은 브랜드의 같은 디자인인데 색만 다른 드레스를 각각 입고 등장해 눈길을 끌었습니다. 

수지는 싱그러운 핑크 드레스로 청순한 분위기를 극대화했습니다. 긴 생머리와 가녀린 모습으로 국민 첫사랑 비주얼을 완성했습니다. 

반면 윤아는 블랙으로 우아하고 시크한 분위기를 냈습니다. 자연스럽게 묶은 헤어스타일이 수지와 대비되는 분위기를 연출했습니다.

누리꾼들은 “같은 옷인데 다른 느낌”, “수지는 청순, 윤아는 시크” 등의 반응을 보였습니다.

id.title: Gaun yang sama di karpet merah... “Suzy polos, Yoona modis” / Bintang YTN
id.description:
Aktris Suzy dan Yoona tampil mengenakan gaun dengan desain yang sama.

Acara karpet merah untuk Penghargaan Seni Baeksang ke-62 diadakan pada tanggal 8 di COEX di Samseong-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul. MC Suzy dan tamu undangan Yoona menarik perhatian dengan tampil mengenakan gaun dengan desain yang sama dari merek yang sama, hanya berbeda warna.

Suzy memaksimalkan aura polosnya dengan gaun merah muda yang menyegarkan. Dengan rambut lurus panjang dan tubuh langsingnya, ia melengkapi penampilan "Cinta Pertama Bangsa".

Di sisi lain, Yoona memancarkan suasana elegan dan anggun dalam balutan busana hitam. Gaya rambutnya yang diikat alami menciptakan suasana yang kontras dengan penampilan Suzy.

Para netizen berkomentar, "Gaun yang sama, aura yang berbeda," dan "Suzy polos, Yoona anggun."

[Hak Cipta (c) YTN. Reproduksi, redistribusi, dan penggunaan data AI tanpa izin dilarang.]

en-US.title: Same dress on the red carpet... “Suzy is innocent, Yoona is chic” / YTN star
en-US.description:
Actresses Suzy and Yoona appeared wearing dresses of the same design.

The red carpet event for the 62nd Baeksang Arts Awards was held on the 8th at COEX in Samseong-dong, Gangnam-gu, Seoul. MC Suzy and attendee Yoona drew attention by appearing in dresses of the same design from the same brand, differing only in color.

Suzy maximized her innocent vibe with a refreshing pink dress. With her long straight hair and slender figure, she completed the "Nation's First Love" look.

On the other hand, Yoona exuded an elegant and chic atmosphere in black. Her naturally tied-up hairstyle created an atmosphere that contrasted with Suzy's.

Netizens commented, "Same dress, different vibe," and "Suzy is innocent, Yoona is chic."

snippet.title: 팝스타 두아 리파, 삼성전자에 220억 소송 제기 / YTN star
snippet.description:
세계적인 팝스타 두아 리파(Dua Lipa)가 삼성전자를 상대로 1,500만 달러(약 220억 원) 규모의 손해배상 청구 소송을 제기했습니다.

지난 8일(현지시간) 캘리포니아 중앙지방법원에 접수된 소장에 따르면, 두아 리파 측은 삼성전자가 TV 제품 포장 박스에 자신의 사진을 허가 없이 사용하며 저작권과 퍼블리시티권을 침해했다고 주장했습니다. 문제가 된 이미지는 ‘2024 오스틴 시티 리미츠 페스티벌’ 백스테이지 사진으로 두아 리파가 독점 저작권을 소유하고 있습니다.

변호인단은 삼성전자가 이 사진을 무단 사용해 마치 가수가 제품을 공식 후원하는 듯한 오해를 불러일으켰다고 지적했습니다. 소장에는 "두아 리파 때문에 TV를 샀다"는 소비자들의 소셜 미디어 게시물이 증거로 포함되었습니다.

특히 리파 측은 2025년 6월부터 사용 중단을 요구했으나 삼성이 이를 무시했다고 비판했습니다. 또한 푸마, 베르사체 등 프리미엄 브랜드와만 선별적으로 파트너십을 맺어온 점을 강조하며, 이번 무단 사용이 브랜드 가치를 심각하게 훼손했다고 주장했습니다. 현재 리파 측은 1,500만 달러의 배상금과 사용 금지 명령을 요청한 상태입니다.

[저작권자(c) YTN 무단전재, 재배포 및 AI 데이터 활용 금지]

id.title: Bintang pop Dua Lipa mengajukan gugatan senilai 22 miliar won terhadap Samsung Electronics / Bint...
id.description:
Bintang pop global Dua Lipa telah mengajukan gugatan terhadap Samsung Electronics, menuntut ganti rugi sebesar $15 juta (sekitar 22 miliar KRW).

Menurut gugatan yang diajukan ke Pengadilan Distrik Pusat California pada tanggal 8 (waktu setempat), pihak Dua Lipa mengklaim bahwa Samsung Electronics melanggar hak cipta dan hak publisitasnya dengan menggunakan fotonya pada kotak kemasan produk TV tanpa izin. Gambar yang dimaksud adalah foto di belakang panggung dari ‘Festival Austin City Limits 2024,’ yang hak ciptanya dimiliki secara eksklusif oleh Dua Lipa.

Tim hukumnya menunjukkan bahwa penggunaan foto tanpa izin oleh Samsung Electronics menciptakan kesalahpahaman bahwa penyanyi tersebut secara resmi mensponsori produk tersebut. Gugatan tersebut menyertakan unggahan media sosial dari konsumen yang menyatakan, "Saya membeli TV ini karena Dua Lipa," sebagai bukti.

Secara khusus, pihak Lipa mengkritik Samsung karena mengabaikan permintaan mereka untuk menghentikan penggunaan tersebut mulai Juni 2025. Lebih lanjut, dengan menekankan bahwa Samsung hanya bermitra secara selektif dengan merek-merek premium seperti Puma dan Versace, mereka berpendapat bahwa penggunaan tanpa izin ini telah sangat merusak nilai merek mereka. Saat ini, Lipa telah meminta ganti rugi sebesar $15 juta dan perintah penghentian penggunaan tersebut.

[Hak Cipta (c) YTN. Reproduksi, redistribusi, dan penggunaan data AI tanpa izin dilarang.]

en-US.title: Pop star Dua Lipa files 22 billion won lawsuit against Samsung Electronics / YTN star
en-US.description:
Global pop star Dua Lipa has filed a lawsuit against Samsung Electronics seeking $15 million (approximately 22 billion KRW) in damages.

According to the complaint filed with the Central District Court of California on the 8th (local time), Dua Lipa's side claims that Samsung Electronics infringed on her copyright and publicity rights by using her photo on TV product packaging boxes without permission. The image in question is a backstage photo from the ‘2024 Austin City Limits Festival,’ for which Dua Lipa holds the exclusive copyright.

Her legal team pointed out that Samsung Electronics’ unauthorized use of the photo created the misconception that the singer was officially sponsoring the product. The complaint includes social media posts from consumers stating, "I bought the TV because of Dua Lipa," as evidence.

In particular, Lipa's side criticized Samsung for ignoring their request to cease use starting June 2025. Furthermore, emphasizing that Samsung has selectively partnered only with premium brands such as Puma and Versace, they argued that this unauthorized use has seriously damaged their brand value. Ripa has currently requested $15 million in damages and an injunction against its use.

지난 8일(현지시간) 캘리포니아 중앙지방법원에 접수된 소장에 따르면, 두아 리파 측은 삼성전자가 TV 제품 포장 박스에 자신의 사진을 허가 없이 사용하며 저작권과 퍼블리시티권을 침해했다고 주장했습니다. 문제가 된 이미지는 ‘2024 오스틴 시티 리미츠 페스티벌’ 백스테이지 사진으로 두아 리파가 독점 저작권을 소유하고 있습니다.

변호인단은 삼성전자가 이 사진을 무단 사용해 마치 가수가 제품을 공식 후원하는 듯한 오해를 불러일으켰다고 지적했습니다. 소장에는 "두아 리파 때문에 TV를 샀다"는 소비자들의 소셜 미디어 게시물이 증거로 포함되었습니다.

특히 리파 측은 2025년 6월부터 사용 중단을 요구했으나 삼성이 이를 무시했다고 비판했습니다. 또한 푸마, 베르사체 등 프리미엄 브랜드와만 선별적으로 파트너십을 맺어온 점을 강조하며, 이번 무단 사용이 브랜드 가치를 심각하게 훼손했다고 주장했습니다. 현재 리파 측은 1,500만 달러의 배상금과 사용 금지 명령을 요청한 상태입니다.

id.description:
Ini adalah Star Newsroom, pusat berita hiburan.

Kami menghadirkan aktivitas I.O.I, yang mengumumkan reuni mereka setelah 9 tahun, dan "Pasangan Sun-Jae," Kim Hye-yoon dan Byun Woo-seok, yang kembali dengan proyek baru. Kami juga meliput pertemuan yang ramai dibicarakan antara Park Bo-gum dan Jang Won-young, serta kabar terbaru tentang Yoo Seung-jun, yang terlihat di konser Tae Jin-ah.

Setelah itu, kami membahas berbagai topik, termasuk film baru sutradara Yeon Sang-ho *The Hive*, tren box office terkini, dan berita tentang rilis internasional yang sedang tren. Dalam "Wawancara Bintang Terpancar," kami bertemu dengan penyanyi Choi Yena, yang dicintai karena energinya yang ceria dan pesonanya yang jujur.

Simak semuanya, mulai dari isu-isu yang sedang memanas di industri hiburan hingga tantangan baru para bintang saat ini!

en-US.description:
Singer Choi Yena, who has proven her status as a trending star through the viral "Catch Catch" dance challenge, will be joining "Star Newsroom."

Choi Yena, who is currently at the peak of her popularity with her fifth mini-album "Love Catcher," will appear on the "Berry Star Interview" segment of "Star Newsroom," airing on Saturday, May 9 at 9 AM. She will share behind-the-scenes stories about the production of the new album's title track, "Catch Catch," as well as her affection for her fans and her plans for future activities.

Presented by YTN and Berry Media, "Star Newsroom" plans to deliver major entertainment news and various behind-the-scenes stories in a lively manner. It airs on GTV every Saturday at 9 AM and is also released on the YTN star YouTube channel every Saturday at 9 AM.

snippet.description:

id.title: Kesempatan bagus untuk penggemar Woods?... Pernyataan dirilis terkait kontroversi 'perekrutan tan...
id.description:
Agensi penyanyi WOODZ (nama asli Jo Seung-yeon) telah mengeluarkan permintaan maaf resmi terkait kontroversi yang disebut "gaji berdasarkan gairah" yang muncul selama proses perekrutan staf di lokasi untuk konser luar negerinya.

Baru-baru ini, lowongan pekerjaan untuk staf tur dunia WOODZ, "Archive. 1," diunggah ke komunitas online lokal Jerman.

Lowongan tersebut mencantumkan kualifikasi tingkat tinggi, termasuk kefasihan dalam tiga bahasa (Korea, Jerman, dan Inggris), diutamakan pengalaman konser K-pop, dan pengetahuan tentang pencahayaan dan suara. Namun, perlakuan sebenarnya ditentukan sebagai "tidak dibayar," dengan kompensasi terbatas pada makanan dan tiket konser.

Inti dari kritik tersebut berpusat pada fakta bahwa ini adalah konser komersial dengan harga tinggi, dengan tiket VIP seharga sekitar 420.000 KRW dan tiket masuk umum mencapai 150.000 KRW. Setelah kontroversi tersebut, pengunggah menjelaskan, "Saya mengunggahnya karena ini bisa menjadi kesempatan yang baik bagi penggemar," tetapi reaksi publik tidak mereda.

Saat situasi memburuk, agensi WOODZ, EDAM Entertainment, mengeluarkan pernyataan resmi pada tanggal 8 dan menyampaikan permintaan maaf. Agensi tersebut menyatakan, "Kami telah mengkonfirmasi kekurangan operasional dari penyelenggara konser lokal," dan menambahkan, "Kami dengan tulus meminta maaf karena tidak cukup meninjau detailnya terlebih dahulu."

[Hak cipta (c) YTN. Reproduksi, redistribusi, dan penggunaan data AI tanpa izin dilarang.]

en-US.title: A good opportunity for Woods fans?... Statement released on 'unpaid hiring' controversy / YTN star
en-US.description:
The agency of singer WOODZ (real name Jo Seung-yeon) has issued an official apology regarding the so-called "passion pay" controversy that arose during the recruitment process for on-site staff for his overseas concerts.

Recently, a job posting for staff for WOODZ's world tour, "Archive. 1," was uploaded to a local German online community.

The posting listed high-level qualifications, including fluency in three languages ​​(Korean, German, and English), preference for K-pop concert experience, and knowledge of lighting and sound. However, the actual terms specified were "unpaid," with compensation limited to meals and tickets to the concert.

The core of the criticism centered on the fact that this was a high-priced commercial concert, with VIP tickets costing approximately 420,000 KRW and general admission tickets reaching 150,000 KRW. Following the controversy, the poster explained, "I uploaded it because it could be a good opportunity for fans," but the public backlash did not subside.

As the situation escalated, WOODZ's agency, EDAM Entertainment, issued an official statement on the 8th and bowed its head in apology. The agency stated, "We have confirmed operational deficiencies by the local concert organizer," adding, "We sincerely apologize for not having sufficiently reviewed the details in advance."

snippet.title: "최대 피해자는 1층 손님" 유명 와인 유튜버, 모수 논란 언급 / YTN star
snippet.description:
구독자 69만 명을 보유한 유명 와인 유튜버 '와인킹'이 안성재 셰프의 '모수 서울'에서 불거진 와인 빈티지 바꿔치기 논란에 대해 언급했습니다.

와인킹은 지난 3일 자신의 유튜브 채널을 통해 이번 사건의 최대 피해자가 문제를 제기한 고객이 아닐 수 있다고 강조했습니다. 

그는 "가장 큰 피해자는 2층에서 클레임을 제기한 손님이 아니라 같은 와인을 병째 주문해 조용히 마시고 있던 1층 손님일 가능성이 크다"며 "그 손님은 지금도 본인이 피해자라는 사실을 모를 수 있다"고 했습니다.

와인킹은 병째 주문한 와인의 소유권 문제에 대해 짚었습니다. 그는 "와인 한 병을 주문했다는 것은 해당 와인을 온전히 구매한 것"이라며 "그 와인이 다른 테이블 서비스에 활용됐다면 고객의 권리를 침해한 것이고 2층 손님에게 보여준 2000년 빈티지 병이 1층 손님의 것이라면, 해당 와인이 다른 고객 응대에 사용된 것 아니냐는 의문이 생긴다"고 주장했습니다.

또 "2000년과 2005년 빈티지는 레이블부터 확연히 다르다. 와인에 조금이라도 관심 있는 사람이라면 혼동하기 어렵다"며 "단순 실수가 아니라고 생각한다"고 했습니다. 

[저작권자(c) YTN 무단전재, 재배포 및 AI 데이터 활용 금지]

en-US.title: "The biggest victim is the first-floor customers," famous wine YouTuber comments on sample size c...
en-US.description:
"Wine King," a famous wine YouTuber with 690,000 subscribers, commented on the controversy regarding the swapping of wine vintages that arose at Chef Ahn Sung-jae's restaurant, "Mosu Seoul."

On the 3rd, Wine King emphasized via his YouTube channel that the biggest victim of this incident may not be the customer who raised the issue.

"It is highly likely that the biggest victim is not the customer on the second floor who filed the complaint, but the customer on the first floor who quietly drank the same wine ordered by the bottle," he said. "That customer may still not know that they are the victim."

Wine King addressed the issue of ownership regarding wine ordered by the bottle. He argued, "Ordering a bottle of wine means purchasing that wine in its entirety. If that wine was used to serve another table, it infringes upon the customer's rights. Furthermore, if the 2000 vintage bottle shown to the customer on the second floor actually belonged to the customer on the first floor, it raises the question of whether that wine was used to serve another customer."

Wine King He also stated, "The 2000 and 2005 vintages are distinctly different, starting with the labels. It would be difficult for anyone with even a little interest in wine to confuse them," adding, "I do not think it was a simple mistake."

id.title: "Korban terbesar adalah pelanggan di lantai pertama," komentar YouTuber anggur terkenal tentang k...
id.description:
"Wine King," seorang YouTuber anggur terkenal dengan 690.000 pelanggan, mengomentari kontroversi mengenai pertukaran anggur yang terjadi di restoran Chef Ahn Sung-jae, "Mosu Seoul."

Pada tanggal 3, Wine King menekankan melalui saluran YouTube-nya bahwa korban terbesar dari insiden ini mungkin bukan pelanggan yang mengajukan masalah tersebut.

"Sangat mungkin bahwa korban terbesar bukanlah pelanggan di lantai dua yang mengajukan keluhan, tetapi pelanggan di lantai satu yang diam-diam meminum anggur yang sama yang dipesan per botol," katanya. "Pelanggan itu mungkin masih belum tahu bahwa mereka adalah korban."

Wine King membahas masalah kepemilikan terkait anggur yang dipesan per botol. Ia berpendapat, "Memesan sebotol anggur berarti membeli anggur tersebut secara keseluruhan. Jika anggur itu digunakan untuk melayani meja lain, itu melanggar hak pelanggan. Lebih jauh lagi, jika botol anggur vintage 2000 yang ditunjukkan kepada pelanggan di lantai dua sebenarnya milik pelanggan di lantai satu, hal itu menimbulkan pertanyaan apakah anggur itu digunakan untuk melayani pelanggan lain."

Raja Anggur Ia juga menyatakan, "Anggur vintage 2000 dan 2005 sangat berbeda, dimulai dari labelnya. Akan sulit bagi siapa pun yang sedikit tertarik pada anggur untuk mengacaukannya," menambahkan, "Saya rasa itu bukan kesalahan sederhana."

[Hak Cipta (c) YTN. Reproduksi, redistribusi, dan penggunaan data AI tanpa izin dilarang.]

snippet.description:
배우 기은세가 SNS에 올린 의미심장한 메시지로 주목받고 있습니다. 

기은세는 지난 7일 자신의 SNS에 생선구이 사진을 올리며 "따뜻한 세상이었으면"이라는 메시지를 적었습니다. 

같은 날 기은세는 소속사를 통해 단독주택 리모델링 과정에서 불거진 민폐 공사 논란에 대해 사과했습니다. 이에 본인의 심경을 간접적으로 표현한 게시물이 아니냐는 추측이 이어졌습니다. 

기은세는 서울 종로구 평창동 단독주택으로 이사를 하기 위해 리모델링 공사를 진행하고 있는 가운데, 이웃 주민이 기은세의 집 공사로 인해 피해를 보고 있다는 글을 올려 논란에 휩싸였습니다. 

이웃 주민은 "집 앞 골목은 공사 차량들이 점령해서 주민들은 차 한 대 지나가기도 버겁다. 공사 쓰레기에 먼지까지 가득한데 동네 청소조차 제대로 안 되어 있다"라며 문제를 제기했습니다. 

이에 기은세의 소속사 측은 "불편을 제기하신 주민분께 사과를 드리고 동네 청소를 완료하였고, 차량 통행 불편함에 대해서도 빠르게 조치를 취했다"라며 "심려를 끼쳐드린 점 양해 부탁드린다"라고 사과했습니다.

en-US.title: Post by Ki Eun-se on Social Media After Apology Amid 'Controversy Over Nuisance Construction at P...
en-US.description:
Actress Ki Eun-se is drawing attention for a cryptic message she posted on social media.

On the 7th, Ki Eun-se posted a photo of grilled fish on her social media along with the message, "I wish it were a warm world."

On the same day, Ki Eun-se apologized through her agency regarding the controversy over disruptive construction work that arose during the remodeling of her detached house. This led to speculation that the post was an indirect expression of her feelings.

Ki Eun-se is currently undergoing remodeling work to move into a detached house in Pyeongchang-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul. She became embroiled in controversy after a neighbor posted a message claiming they were suffering damages due to the construction at her home.

The neighbor raised the issue, stating, "The alley in front of the house is occupied by construction vehicles, making it difficult for residents to even let a single car pass. It is filled with construction debris and dust, yet the neighborhood isn't even being properly cleaned." In response, Ki Eun-se's agency issued an apology, stating, "We have apologized to the resident who raised the issue, completed cleaning the neighborhood, and promptly taken measures regarding the inconvenience to vehicle traffic," and added, "We ask for your understanding regarding the concern caused."

id.title: Unggahan Ki Eun-se di Media Sosial Setelah Permintaan Maaf di Tengah 'Kontroversi Mengenai Konstr...
id.description:
Aktris Ki Eun-se menarik perhatian karena pesan samar yang ia unggah di media sosial.

Pada tanggal 7, Ki Eun-se mengunggah foto ikan bakar di media sosialnya bersama pesan, "Aku berharap dunia ini hangat."

Pada hari yang sama, Ki Eun-se meminta maaf melalui agensinya terkait kontroversi mengenai pekerjaan konstruksi yang mengganggu selama renovasi rumahnya. Hal ini menimbulkan spekulasi bahwa unggahan tersebut merupakan ekspresi tidak langsung dari perasaannya.

Ki Eun-se saat ini sedang menjalani renovasi untuk pindah ke rumah di Pyeongchang-dong, Jongno-gu, Seoul. Ia terlibat kontroversi setelah seorang tetangga mengunggah pesan yang mengklaim mereka mengalami kerugian akibat konstruksi di rumahnya.

Tetangga tersebut mengangkat masalah ini, dengan menyatakan, "Gang di depan rumah ditempati oleh kendaraan konstruksi, sehingga menyulitkan warga untuk sekadar lewat satu mobil pun. Gang tersebut dipenuhi puing-puing dan debu konstruksi, namun lingkungan sekitar bahkan tidak dibersihkan dengan benar." Sebagai tanggapan, agensi Ki Eun-se mengeluarkan permintaan maaf, menyatakan, "Kami telah meminta maaf kepada warga yang menyampaikan masalah tersebut, telah menyelesaikan pembersihan lingkungan, dan segera mengambil tindakan terkait ketidaknyamanan lalu lintas kendaraan," dan menambahkan, "Kami mohon pengertian Anda terkait kekhawatiran yang ditimbulkan."

[Hak cipta (c) YTN. Reproduksi, redistribusi, dan penggunaan data AI tanpa izin dilarang.]

snippet.title: "아버지 시력 거의 잃어"...수영이 밝힌 소녀시대의 진짜 우정/ YTN star
snippet.description:
그룹 소녀시대의 멤버 수영 씨가 망막색소변성증 투병 중인 아버지의 사연을 전하며, 멤버들에게 고마운 마음을 표현했습니다.

지난 6일, 수영 씨는 tvN ‘유 퀴즈 온 더 블록’에 출연해 15년째 투병 중인 아버지와 실명퇴치운동본부 활동 이야기를 공개했는데요. 그동안 혼자 조용히 봉사를 이어왔다는 수영 씨는 멤버 유리의 진심 어린 한마디가 큰 위안이 됐다고 밝혔습니다.

수영 씨는 “유리가 어느 날 ‘아빠가 그렇게 좋은 일 하시는데 왜 나한테 얘기 안 했어? 그런 게 있으면 빨리 말을 해줘야지’라고 하더라”며 당시 상황을 회상했습니다. 그 이후로 멤버들은 꾸준히 기부에 동참하고 있으며, 수영 씨는 이에 대해 “가족의 일까지 같이 짊어지는 느낌을 받는다”고 전했습니다.

특히 아버지가 이제는 시력이 거의 보이지 않는 상태라고 밝힌 수영 씨는 “말하지 않아도 ‘도울 수 있으면 돕자’고 알아주는 존재가 있다는 게 큰 위안이 된다”며 멤버들과의 끈끈한 우정을 자랑했습니다.

함께 출연한 유리 씨 역시 “어느 순간 일 외에도 가족 일까지 당연히 챙겨야 하는 때가 아닌가 생각했다”며, “나도 멤버들에게 그런 도움을 받은 적이 있다. 그 힘이 절 지지한다고 느꼈을 때 어떤 일이든 힘들지 않다는 생각이 들었다”고 화답해 훈훈함을 더했습니다.


[저작권자(c) YTN 무단전재, 재배포 및 AI 데이터 활용 금지]

en-US.title: "My father has almost lost his eyesight"... Sooyoung reveals the true friendship of Girls' Genera...
en-US.description:
Sooyoung, a member of the group Girls' Generation, shared the story of her father, who is battling retinitis pigmentosa, and expressed her gratitude to her fellow members.

On the 6th, Sooyoung appeared on tvN’s “You Quiz on the Block” and revealed stories about her father, who has been fighting the disease for 15 years, and her activities with the Korea Blindness Eradication Movement Headquarters. Sooyoung, who had been quietly continuing her volunteer work alone, stated that a heartfelt remark from member Yuri was a great source of comfort.

Recalling the situation, Sooyoung said, “One day, Yuri asked, ‘Dad is doing such good work, why didn’t you tell me? You should have told me sooner if something like that happened.’” Since then, the members have consistently participated in donations, and Sooyoung commented on this, saying, “I feel like we are shouldering the burden of my family’s affairs together.”

In particular, Sooyoung, who revealed that her father’s eyesight is now almost non-existent, boasted of the strong friendship with her members, saying, “It is a great comfort to have someone who understands and says, ‘Let’s help if we can,’ even without me having to say anything.”

Yuri, who appeared alongside her, also added to the heartwarming atmosphere by responding, “At some point, I thought that it was only natural to take care of family matters in addition to work,” and added, “I have also received such help from the members. When I felt that strength was supporting me, I felt that nothing was difficult.”

[Copyright (c) YTN. Unauthorized reproduction, redistribution, and use of AI data are prohibited.]

id.title: "Ayah hampir kehilangan penglihatan"... Sooyoung ungkap persahabatan sejati Girls' Generation/ YT...
id.description:
Sooyoung, anggota grup Girls' Generation, berbagi kisah tentang ayahnya yang sedang berjuang melawan retinitis pigmentosa, dan mengungkapkan rasa terima kasihnya kepada sesama anggota.

Pada tanggal 6, Sooyoung tampil di acara tvN “You Quiz on the Block” dan mengungkapkan kisah tentang ayahnya yang telah berjuang melawan penyakit tersebut selama 15 tahun, dan aktivitasnya dengan Markas Besar Gerakan Pemberantasan Kebutaan Korea. Sooyoung, yang diam-diam melanjutkan pekerjaan sukarelawannya sendirian, menyatakan bahwa ucapan tulus dari anggota Yuri merupakan sumber penghiburan yang besar.

Mengenang situasi tersebut, Sooyoung berkata, “Suatu hari, Yuri bertanya, ‘Ayah melakukan pekerjaan yang sangat baik, mengapa kamu tidak memberitahuku? Seharusnya kamu memberitahuku lebih awal jika hal seperti itu terjadi.’” Sejak itu, para anggota secara konsisten berpartisipasi dalam donasi, dan Sooyoung berkomentar tentang hal ini, dengan mengatakan, “Saya merasa seperti kita memikul beban urusan keluarga bersama-sama.”

Secara khusus, Sooyoung, yang mengungkapkan bahwa penglihatan ayahnya kini hampir hilang, membanggakan persahabatan yang kuat dengan para anggotanya, dengan mengatakan, “Sungguh melegakan memiliki seseorang yang mengerti dan berkata, ‘Mari kita bantu jika kita bisa,’ bahkan tanpa saya harus mengatakan apa pun.”

Yuri, yang tampil bersamanya, juga menambah suasana hangat dengan menjawab, “Pada suatu titik, saya berpikir bahwa mengurus urusan keluarga di samping pekerjaan adalah hal yang wajar,” dan menambahkan, “Saya juga menerima bantuan seperti itu dari para anggota. Ketika saya merasakan kekuatan itu mendukung saya, saya merasa tidak ada yang sulit.”

[Hak Cipta (c) YTN. Reproduksi, redistribusi, dan penggunaan data AI tanpa izin dilarang.]

함께 출연한 유리 씨 역시 “어느 순간 일 외에도 가족 일까지 당연히 챙겨야 하는 때가 아닌가 생각했다”며, “나도 멤버들에게 그런 도움을 받은 적이 있다. 그 힘이 절 지지한다고 느꼈을 때 어떤 일이든 힘들지 않다는 생각이 들었다”고 화답해 훈훈함을 더했습니다.

snippet.title: '왕사남' 박지훈의 군대 쿡방 드라마…'취사병 전설이 되다' 제작발표회/ YTN star
snippet.description:
'단종 오빠' 박지훈이 이번엔 흙수저 취사병으로 돌아온다. 

지난 6일 오후 서울 광진구 풀만 앰배서더 서울에서 티빙 오리지널 시리즈 '취사병 전설이 되다' 제작발표회가 열렸다. 현장에는 조남형 감독과 배우 박지훈, 윤경호, 한동희, 이홍내, 이상이 등이 참석했다.

동명의 인기 웹툰을 원작으로 하는 ‘취사병 전설이 되다’는 총 대신 식칼을, 탄띠 대신 앞치마를 두른 이등병 강성재(박지훈 분)가 ‘전설의 취사병’으로 거듭나는 과정을 그린 밀리터리 쿡방 판타지 드라마다. 

특히 영화 '왕과 사는 남자'로 천만 배우 반열에 오른 박지훈의 차기작으로 더욱 화제를 모았다. 박지훈은 지난달 29일 첫 싱글앨범 발매 후 이번 작품까지 쉼없이 달리고 있다. 

[저작권자(c) YTN 무단전재, 재배포 및 AI 데이터 활용 금지]

en-US.title: 'The King's Son' Park Ji-hoon's military cooking drama... 'Becoming a Legendary Cook' production ...
en-US.description:
Park Ji-hoon, known as "Danjong Oppa," returns this time as a cook from a humble background.

A press conference for the TVING original series *Legendary Cook* was held on the afternoon of the 6th at the Pullman Ambassador Seoul in Gwangjin-gu, Seoul. Director Jo Nam-hyung and actors Park Ji-hoon, Yoon Kyung-ho, Han Dong-hee, Lee Hong-nae, and Lee Sang-yi were in attendance.

Based on the popular webtoon of the same name, *Legendary Cook* is a military cooking fantasy drama that depicts the journey of Private Kang Sung-jae (played by Park Ji-hoon), who replaces his gun with a kitchen knife and his ammunition belt with an apron, as he is reborn as a "legendary cook."

It has garnered particular attention as the next project for Park Ji-hoon, who joined the ranks of "10 Million Actors" with the film *The King and the Clown*. Park Ji-hoon has been working non-stop, following the release of his first single album on the 29th of last month with this latest project. [Copyright (c) YTN. snippet.title: 안성재 ‘와인 교체 논란’ 여파…광고 영상 댓글 중지/ YTN star
snippet.description:
안성재 셰프의 레스토랑이 ‘와인 바꿔치기’ 논란에 휩싸인 가운데 안성재를 최근 홍보대사로 발탁한 한돈 홍보에도 불똥이 튀었습니다. 

한돈자조금관리위원회는 지난달 ‘2026년 한돈 TV 캠페인 프리런칭편’을 공개했는데 안성재가 홍보모델로 출연한 프리런칭편과 본편 2편 등 총 3편의 광고가 홍보 활동의 중심축이라는 게 한돈 측 설명입니다. 

그러나 공교롭게도 한돈 TV CF가 본격 공개된 시기에 와인 바꿔치기 논란이 터졌습니다.

7일 현재 한돈자조금 공식 유튜브 채널 ‘밥상위의 국가대표 우리돼지 한돈’에는 안성재가 출연한 TV CF 영상 총 4편의 댓글이 모두 막혀 있습니다. 

다른 영상들의 댓글 사용은 허용돼 있지만, 안성재 출연 영상만 댓글이 중지된 것으로 볼 때 이번 논란과 관련한 악성 댓글이 달릴 것을 우려한 조치로 보입니다. 

한편 안성재는 와인 바꿔치기 논란과 관련해 지난 6일 직접 사과했습다.

안성재는 SNS에 “최근 제 업장인 모수에서 발생한 미흡한 서비스로 실망을 드린 점을 다시 한번 정중히 사과드린다"며 “해당 소믈리에는 회사 규정에 따라 경위서를 제출하도록 했고 앞으로 고객님의 와인을 담당하는 소믈리에 포지션에서 배제하는 조치를 취했다”고 했습니다. 

또 “이번 일을 계기로 레스토랑의 본질과 외식업 종사자로서의 올바른 자세, 음식과 고객을 향한 진심 어린 마음을 잊지 않고 초심을 지키며 더욱 겸손하게 정진하겠다”고 덧붙였습니다. 

[저작권자(c) YTN 무단전재, 재배포 및 AI 데이터 활용 금지]

en-US.title: Aftermath of Ahn Sung-jae’s ‘Wine Replacement Controversy’… Comments on Commercial Video Suspende...
en-US.description:
As Chef Ahn Sung-jae's restaurant becomes embroiled in a "wine swap" controversy, the fallout has also spilled over into the promotion of Han-don, for which he was recently appointed as a brand ambassador.

The Korea Pork Self-Funding Management Committee released the "2026 Han-don TV Campaign Pre-launch Episode" last month. According to Han-don, a total of three commercials—including the pre-launch episode and two main episodes featuring Ahn Sung-jae as the promotional model—serve as the central axis of their promotional activities.

However, coincidentally, the wine swap controversy erupted just as the Han-don TV commercials were officially released.

As of the 7th, comments have been disabled on all four TV commercial videos featuring Ahn Sung-jae on the committee's official YouTube channel, "Han-don, the National Representative of Our Pork on the Table."

Given that comments are suspended only for the videos featuring Ahn Sung-jae while they remain enabled for other videos, this appears to be a measure taken out of concern that malicious comments related to the current controversy might be posted. Meanwhile, Ahn Sung-jae personally apologized on the 6th regarding the wine swap controversy.

On social media, Ahn stated, “I once again respectfully apologize for disappointing you with the inadequate service that recently occurred at my establishment, Mosu.” He added, “In accordance with company regulations, the sommelier in question has been required to submit a report explaining the circumstances, and measures have been taken to exclude them from the position of sommelier responsible for customers’ wines in the future.”

He further added, “Taking this incident as an opportunity, I will not forget the essence of a restaurant, the proper attitude of a food service professional, and a sincere heart toward food and customers. I will maintain my initial resolve and strive to improve with greater humility.”

snippet.title: 김선호, 탈세 의혹 후 첫 공식석상...“매 순간 최선 다했다” / YTN star
snippet.description:
배우 김선호 씨가 탈세 의혹 이후 처음으로 공식석상에 나서 프로그램에 임한 진심을 전했습니다.

김선호 씨는 오늘(6일) 서울 중구 명동 커뮤니티하우스 마실에서 열린 쿠팡플레이 새 예능 ‘봉주르빵집’ 제작발표회에 참석했습니다. 지난 2월 탈세 의혹 이후 첫 공식 석상입니다.

이날 김선호 씨는 “어르신들에게 힐링을 드리고 또 힐링을 받는 의미 있는 프로그램이라 정말 열심히 임했다”며 “어르신들이 주인공이라는 마음으로 매 순간 최선을 다했다”고 밝혔습니다. 이어 “제가 없는 순간에도 빈자리가 느껴지지 않도록 최선을 다하려 했다”고 거듭 강조했습니다.

앞서 김선호 씨는 지난 2월 가족이 관여한 1인 법인을 통해 활동 정산금을 수령한 뒤 개인소득세를 추가 납부한 사실이 알려지며 탈세 의혹에 휩싸였습니다. 당시 소속사는 “관련 세금은 모두 납부를 마쳤고 법인도 폐업 절차를 밟고 있다”고 해명했습니다.


[저작권자(c) YTN 무단전재, 재배포 및 AI 데이터 활용 금지]

en-US.title: Kim Seon-ho Makes First Official Appearance Since Tax Evasion Allegations... “I Did My Best Every...
en-US.description:
Actor Kim Seon-ho made his first official public appearance since the tax evasion allegations and conveyed his sincerity regarding his participation in the program.

Kim Seon-ho attended the press conference for Coupang Play's new variety show "Bonjour Bakery," held today (the 6th) at Community House Masil in Myeong-dong, Jung-gu, Seoul. This marks his first official public appearance since the tax evasion allegations surfaced last February.

On this day, Kim stated, "I approached this program with great dedication because it is a meaningful one where I both give and receive healing from the elderly," adding, "I did my best every moment with the mindset that the seniors are the main characters." He further emphasized, "I tried my utmost to ensure that my absence would not be felt even when I was not present."

Previously, Kim Seon-ho was embroiled in tax evasion allegations last February after it was revealed that he had received settlement payments for his activities through a one-person corporation involving his family and subsequently paid additional personal income tax. At the time, his agency clarified, "All related taxes have been paid, and the corporation is currently undergoing closure procedures."
